risk_note: H5 shell account-switch isolation (apps/h5 shell, shared api and query; RV1). On the bridge event auth.changed the shell (single subscription via bridge-sdk on(), independent of page mounts) cancels and clears the React Query cache and remounts the page tree; the app API client keeps one token manager per account session so requests from an old session fail before acquiring a token, before sending and after the response, never re-acquiring or sending with the old token; queries run per account generation so old-generation query functions refetched after a clear (e.g. a refresh queued before logout) reject without a token or request; on logout anonymous routes (auth none) stay rendered while login-required pages are taken down without requests until the next login. Fixes the account-switch exposure found in the F1-04b review that also affected the merged /ledger page. Rule tests by Codex in two calls; Claude spec-test review r2 pass; red on the test machine (red/2: 14 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in three rounds; test machine verify-fast/4 and browser green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34 / 36). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 fail (S1: anonymous page blanked on logout; S1: a pending token fetch re-acquired after logout), round 2 fail (S1: a refresh queued before logout ran through the new session), round 3 pass, no findings

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 pass (3 S2) while the formal red run flagged one case red for a getBy throw, fixed with the S2s in Codex round 2; round 2 pass (2 S2)
